The '''Cupric Islands''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] that was home to large portions of that world's agricultural sector. It was believed that the Islands' fertility was derived from the pheromones of the [[aro'ruul]], which could aid plant growth.<ref name="LoNH" />

During the [[Houk–Weequay conflicts]], the Islands were attacked by [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] forces, which caused [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] to poison much of the Islands' soil. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] declared martial law on the Islands.<ref name="LoNH" />
